name: Guangdong Hongjing Optoelectronic Technology Inc.
summary: Guangdong Hongjing Optoelectronic Technology Inc. focuses on the research, design, development, production, and sale of optical lenses and camera module products in China and internationally. It offers camera photography systems, including panoramic camera lenses and modules, sports camera lenses and modules, AF camera lenses and modules, low-altitude aerial footage solutions and UAV camera modules, and film shooting equipment; smart home cameras, smart home system modules, security surveillance cameras, visible doorbell cameras, and complete security camera system modules; and ADAS lenses, AVM lenses, CMS lenses, in-cabin cameras, and auto-heating and auto-cleaning lenses.
